name: The Stones That Bind Us
summary: The Fallen Hero asks you to free bound servants from four stones. Their release depends on staying close to each stone.

sections.title: The Bound Servants
sections.body: The stones hold servants bound to Razelikh, Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol. You are asked to free nine servants of Razelikh and three servants for each of the other three. Keep close to the stones while freeing them, or the process fails. When the servants are free, return to the Fallen Hero.

faq.q: Who asks me to free the servants?
faq.answer: The Fallen Hero asks you to free servants bound to four stones.
You are asked to free servants of Razelikh, Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol.

faq.q: How many servants must I free?
faq.answer: Free nine servants of Razelikh and three each of Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol.

faq.q: Why must I stay near the stones?
faq.answer: The freeing process fails if you move too far from the stones.

faq.q: Where do I return when the servants are free?
faq.answer: Return to the Fallen Hero when the servants are free.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Stones That Bind Us
